scoutmaster.title: Scoutmaster
scoutmaster.name: Chris Koczan
scoutmaster.description: The Scoutmaster is the adult responsible for working directly with the Scouts providing direction, coaching, and support.

assistantScoutmaster.title: Assistant Scoutmaster
name: Benjamin Shover
Paul Burgeson
Jeff McConnell
Josh Hunt
Greg Butts
JD Darland
Mark Stoddard
Jon Zimmerman
assistantScoutmaster.description: Assistant Scoutmasters work directly alongside the Scoutmaster to deliver the program, serving as key mentors and advisors to the youth leaders.

charterdOrgRep.title: Chartered Organization Representative
charterdOrgRep.name: Erich Schumann
charterdOrgRep.description: Serves as the liaison between the Troop and our Chartered Organization, ensuring mutual alignment and policy compliance.

committeeChair.title: Troop Committee Chair
committeeChair.name: Christopher Beasley
committeeChair.description: Top adult administrator who recruits adult leaders, presides over committee meetings, and approves troop policies.

membershipChair.title: Membership Chair
membershipChair.name: JD Darland
membershipChair.description: Manages the onboarding of new Webelos, transfers, and older youth while assisting families with registration paperwork.

treasurer.title: Treasurer
treasurer.name: Jon Zimmerman
treasurer.description: Manages all troop finances, tracks individual scout accounts, processes payments, and maintains the annual operating budget.

advancementCoordinator.title: Advancement Chair
advancementCoordinator.name: Sharin White
advancementCoordinator.description: Maintains troop advancement records, schedules Boards of Review, and orders badges and awards for Courts of Honor.

activityChair.title: Outdoors/Activity Chair
activityChair.description: Secures reservations, permits, and logistics for campouts, high-adventure trips, and special troop events.

chaplain.title: Chaplain
chaplain.name: Christopher Beasley
chaplain.description: Provides spiritual leadership, ensures a nonsectarian spiritual component at campouts, and guides scouts working on religious emblems.

communications.title: Communications
communications.description: Manages troop newsletters, announcements, email listservs, and outbound marketing materials.

trainingChair.title: Training Chair
trainingChair.description: Tracks youth and adult training records to ensure 100% compliance with Youth Protection Training (YPT) and outdoor safety courses.

equipmentCoordinator.title: Equipment Coordinator
equipmentCoordinator.description: Manages the troop storage shed and trailer, tracking inventory and assisting the Youth Quartermaster with maintenance.

fundraisingChair.title: Fundraising Chair
fundraisingChair.description: Organizes community fundraising events and builds opportunities for scouts to earn money toward their summer camp activities.

popcornKernel.title: Popcorn Kernel
popcornKernel.name: Nicole Eber
popcornKernel.description: Manages the annual popcorn distribution campaign, inventory logistics, prize coordination, and order compliance tracking.

seniorPatrolLeader.title: Senior Patrol Leader
seniorPatrolLeader.description: The top youth leader of the troop. Appoints youth staff, runs troop meetings, chairs the Patrol Leaders' Council (PLC), and coordinates the yearly program calendar.

assistantSeniorPatrolLeader.title: Assistant Senior Patrol Leader
assistantSeniorPatrolLeader.description: Lends operational assistance to the SPL and acts as troop leader when the SPL is absent. Directly oversees appointed support staff and patrol coordination.

troopGuide.title: Troop Guide
troopGuide.description: An experienced older Scout who mentors and guides the newest patrol of Scouts through their first year of transition into the troop.

patrolLeader.title: Patrol Leader
patrolLeader.description: Elected by their peers, a Patrol Leader represents their patrol at PLC meetings, coordinates campouts, delegates tasks, and encourages member advancement.

instructor.title: Instructor
instructor.description: An older, highly proficient Scout who teaches specific outdoor skills, rank requirements, or merit badge material to younger peers.

denChief.title: Den Chief
denChief.description: A Scout who works directly with a local Cub Scout Pack, assisting Den Leaders and acting as a bridge to recruit future Scouts.

juniorASM.title: Junior Assistant Scoutmaster
juniorASM.description: A Scout at least 16 years old who functions essentially as an adult leader, providing specialized mentorship under the Scoutmaster's supervision.

quartermaster.title: Quartermaster
quartermaster.description: Maintains troop gear, coordinates trailer pack outs for trips, and issues equipment during campouts.

historian.title: Historian
historian.description: Captures photos and videos during troop outings and maintains the troop archive or newsletter content.

scribe.title: Scribe
scribe.description: The youth secretary who takes minutes at PLC meetings, tracks attendance logs, and assists leadership with recordkeeping.

bugler.title: Bugler
bugler.description: Plays assembly, reveille, and taps calls at troop meetings and morning/evening flag ceremonies on campouts.

chaplainAide.title: Chaplain's Aide
chaplainAide.description: Leads nonsectarian prayers at meals and scouts' own services during weekend outdoor trips.

webmaster.title: Webmaster
webmaster.description: Assists in updating and maintaining materials on the troop website.

oaRepresentative.title: Order of the Arrow Representative
oaRepresentative.description: Serves as the link between the local OA Honor Society Chapter and the troop, promoting lodge events and camping traditions.

outdoorEthicsGuide.title: Outdoor Ethics Guide
outdoorEthicsGuide.description: Ensures the troop adheres to Leave No Trace and Tread Lightly principles during all backcountry operations.
